Also attaching our vendor requirements summary to provide context on any additional items our procurement team will flag.

If you can provide the SOC2 redacted report and a BAA template, we can move quickly.

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below:

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II attestation for the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. I have a redacted copy of the report — sharing via secure link below. If you need a full copy under an NDA we can arrange that.

3) Data flows: In hosted API mode, customer content is encrypted in transit and at rest. By default, we do not persist conversational data long-term for Redwoods' hosted service (configurable retention windows). For customers requiring PHI retention, Private deployment is recommended. I asked our security team for a 1-page data flow diagram — attaching it as part of the SIG spreadsheet below.

4) Questionnaire format & timeline: SIG (CSV) works fine. We will populate the SIG initiation spreadsheet and return a filled CSV within your 30-day window. If any items require longer (e.g., architecture diagrams), we'll flag them and propose a date.
